hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path'),cp=require('node:child_process');let r=process.cwd();while(!fs.existsSync(p.join(r,'.geppetto/bin/hook.mjs'))){const parent=p.dirname(r);if(parent===r){console.error('Geppetto hook: installed hook.mjs was not found');process.exit(1);}r=parent;}const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[p.join(r,'.geppetto/bin/hook.mjs')],{stdio:'inherit',windowsHide:true});if(result.error){console.error(result.error.message);process.exit(1);}process.exit(result.status??1);"
